selection_rationale: Fixed 1 Mb contiguous interval surrounding the chromosome 9 teaching-validation region, chosen before examining HG002 consequences. Teaching variants remain separate from HG002 totals.
interval_rule: Full anchored REF span [POS-1, POS-1+len(REF)) must lie inside the selected interval and one high-confidence BED interval, both before and after normalization. Insertions use their VCF anchor. No symbolic alleles, breakends, spanning deletion stars, non-ACGT alleles, non-PASS records or absent sample ALT alleles. Small variant alleles have REF and ALT length <=50 bases.
